script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Mosaic

INT. MOZAIC MOSAIC - DAY

A sprawling, modern art museum nestled in the heart of downtown. VISIONARY ARTHUR, in his early 50s, a renowned artist and museum curator, enters. He walks through the grand atrium, taking in the sight of the stunning artwork that adorns the walls.

VISIONARY ARTHUR (V.O.)
The Mosaic - a gallery that celebrates the unity of art and people.

INT. MOZAIC MOSAIC - ART STUDIO - DAY

In the studio, ARTHUR sits at a large table, surrounded by a team of ARTISTS, all diligently working on their latest projects. ARTHUR stands and addresses the team.

ARTHUR
Good morning, team. Today, we welcome a new member to our community. Let's give a warm welcome to...

INT. MOZAIC MOSAIC - ART STUDIO ENTRANCE - DAY

In walks ELIZABETH, a middle-aged woman with a shy smile. She carries a portfolio under her arm. ARTHUR gestures for her to join him at the table.

ELIZABETH (softly)
Thank you, Arthur. I'm excited to be here.

ARTURAL
You're going to fit in perfectly, Elizabeth. Now, let's take a look at some of your work.

INT. MOZAIC MOSAIC - ART STUDIO - DAY

As they discuss her work, a memory flashes in ARTHUR'S mind. Years ago, he had been a mentor to ELIZABETH at a small art school. They had grown close, but he had left suddenly, without a word.

VISIONARY ARTHUR (V.O.)
I made a mistake once before. I won't let history repeat itself.

INT. MOZAIC MOSAIC - ART STUDIO - NIGHT

Later that evening, ARTHUR finds ELIZABETH still working on her latest piece.

ARTHUR
Elizabeth, I need to talk to you about something.

ELIZABETH (looking up, surprised)
Yes, Arthur? What's on your mind?

VISIONARY ARTHUR
I want to apologize for the way things ended between us all those years ago. I made a mistake, and I've regretted it ever since.

ELIZABETH (tearfully)
Arthur, I've carried that guilt with me for so long. I never understood why you left so suddenly.

VISIONARY ARTHUR
It was a difficult time for me, Elizabeth. But I've come to realize that I can't change the past, only the present and the future. And I want a second chance. A chance to make things right.

ELIZABETH (smiling)
Arthur, I accept your apology. And I'm grateful for this opportunity to work with you again.

INT. MOZAIC MOSAIC - ART STUDIO - DAY

Weeks later, the team gathers around to celebrate the opening of their latest exhibit. ARTHUR and ELIZABETH stand together, proud of their accomplishments and the renewed bond they share.

VISIONARY ARTHUR (V.O.)
The Mosaic is more than just a gallery. It's a place where people can come together, heal, and create something beautiful. And I'm grateful to be a part of it.

Fade to black.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
